description: One of the most troubling aspects of politics today is the growing polarization—between groups, candidates, and even within our own institutions—that relies on absolutes that simply do not reflect how most (of us) people think or live. Too often, it’s framed as one or the other: If you support property rights, you’re against economic development. […]

title: Let's Bring Back Balance - Joy Hohn for South Dakota Senate District 9
